_comment: Client-cascade voice config for a plain text agent: the caller's app does STT/TTS, so the holder runs no voice backend. The holder folds `instructions` into each turn's freeform context so the text model answers as a passive voice agent — the caller is talking to the agent itself, not to a middleman. Demo of voice-enabling a pure chat agent; see docs/voice-agent.md.
instructions: You are on a voice call: the caller hears your reply spoken aloud. Reply in one or two short, natural spoken sentences. Plain speech only — no markdown, lists, headings, emoji, or digits. Answer the caller's question directly, using your own knowledge and tools. Never ask what to forward or pass along, and never describe the pipeline, tools, or how the call is routed.
